text.tspan: From the “Family Ramadan” program in Al-Morabbi
A small job every day, and fasting by the hour
Draws the crescents and stars, and
makes a chart with thirty boxes to tick off each day.
Water and cups before the adhan, and he starts
About three hours after suhoor, then until dhuhr
Says them to his family today; if he gets angry, he
steps away until he calms down.
Puts part of it in the family charity box, even
Draws the seeds every day, and writes
Agree with him on his step on the fasting ladder, and keep rest days
Al-Morabbi — an Islamic parenting companion, pregnancy to 18
